levels.surface: محمد بن محمد بن عصام الكليني

notes: al-Faqih's statement of his routes («فقد رويته عن ...») to al-Kulayni, with no saying (rule 11): the three names are the co-transmitters of that route and al-Kulayni is its source; the ruling is for the archive
The first «محمد بن يعقوب الكليني» (occurrence 1) is the subject of the statement, not a link: the route's source is occurrence 2
The closing «عنهم عنه عن رجاله» (all of al-Kafi) is a general clause with no names: left out
